plan.goal: Show Gajanan's total indifference to taste as he mixes and eats the rich meal, and Bankatlal's reversal from calling him mad to declaring him the king of yogis, blessing Shegaon.

turn.text: Bankatlal declares that calling Gajanan mad was undoubtedly a mistake and no further testing is needed.

assets.char: Devidas walking toward door carrying a full plate of rich cooked dishes, side view, transparent background
assets.other: Gajanan seated on ground in front of door, plate not yet placed, neutral pose, transparent background

shots.action: Devidas carries plate to door and sets it before Gajanan
shots.performance: Devidas strides purposefully; Gajanan sits still, gaze downward
shots.camera: pan right with Devidas, then hold on Gajanan
staging: STAGING: Plate enters frame from right as Devidas approaches; door frame in foreground

assets.img: Gajanan seated at plate, hands mixing all dishes into one mass, eating calmly, full body

shots.action: Gajanan mixes dishes together and eats
shots.performance: Hands move steadily, no hesitation, no savoring gestures
shots.camera: slow push in from waist-up to chest-up

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.marathi: अनुपम ब्रह्मरसाला जो पिऊन तृप्त झाला तो कां मागतो गुळवण्याला मिटक्या मारीत बैसेल
dialogue.meaning_en: One who has drunk the incomparable nectar of Brahman and been satisfied — why would he ask for jaggery-water and sit smacking his lips?

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.marathi: जो सार्वभौम नृपवर झाला असे साचार अशा नरासी जहागीर मिळाल्यासी प्रेम नुपजे
dialogue.meaning_en: If a supreme emperor has become such, love does not arise for a petty estate.

staging: STAGING: No lip-smacking, no selective picking; all dishes become one

assets.face: Close-up of Gajanan's face, neutral expression, eyes downcast at food, transparent background

shots.performance: No flicker of pleasure or dislike; breath even, gaze fixed
shots.camera: slow push in on face, breathing sway
staging: STAGING: Hold on still face to show 'चवी न कशाची अंतरीं अणुमात्र उरली असे' — no taste-craving remains, not an atom

assets.left: Bankatlal standing, turned toward left, right hand raised in declarative gesture, transparent background
assets.right: Damodarpant standing, turned toward right, head slightly tilted listening, transparent background

shots.action: Bankatlal gestures toward Gajanan while speaking to Damodarpant
shots.performance: Bankatlal earnest, finger pointing; Damodarpant absorbs, no interruption
shots.camera: gentle drift left to right across both faces

dialogue.speaker: Bankatlal
dialogue.marathi: ह्या वेडा म्हणालों आपण ती निःसंशय झाली चुकी
dialogue.meaning_en: We called him mad; that was undoubtedly a mistake.

dialogue.speaker: Bankatlal
dialogue.marathi: सुभद्रेसाठीं द्वारकेला अर्जुन ऐसाच वेडा झाला व्यवहाराचा विसर पडला करुं लागला भलभलतें
dialogue.meaning_en: For Subhadra's sake at Dwarka, Arjuna went just such a madman; worldly conduct was forgotten, he did odd things.

dialogue.speaker: Bankatlal
dialogue.marathi: तैसाच हा ज्ञानजेठी मुक्तिरुप सुभद्रेसाठीं वेडा झाला कसवटी याची आतां घेणें नको
dialogue.meaning_en: Likewise this eldest-in-knowledge went mad for liberation-form Subhadra; testing him now is not needed.

staging: STAGING: Bankatlal's gesture includes Gajanan off-screen left; Damodarpant does not speak

assets.face: Close-up of Bankatlal's face, reverent expression, hands folded at chest, eyes uplifted, transparent background

shots.action: Bankatlal looks upward with folded hands
shots.performance: Eyes soft, lips move silently; pride and reverence blended
shots.camera: slower push in, soft halo bloom at edges

dialogue.speaker: unclear
dialogue.marathi: धन्य आपुलें शेगांव दृष्टी पाहिला योगीराव निरिच्छा हा जहागीरगांव दिला हरीनें जयाला
dialogue.meaning_en: Blessed is our Shegaon; we have seen the king of yogis with our eyes; Hari gave him the estate of desirelessness.

staging: STAGING: 'आपुलें' (our) marks Bankatlal as Shegaon resident; halo suggests grace, not miracle
